objective: Validate audible two-deck phase lock on the real Windows/browser/audio path and prove the no-hidden-seek invariant before Phase 6 promotion.
setup: Check out the exact requested SHA.
Run python bootstrap.py; require LIBERTAS BOOT: PASS.
Run npm install && npm run check.
Start Vite and open headed Edge/Chrome on the normal physical audio output.
Record Windows/browser/output-device identity, AudioContext sample rate, base/output latency, and render quantum.

tests.instructions: Load generated click pair A=120 BPM, B=128 BPM. Offset B by about 0.30-0.35 beat, play both, enable SYNC B to A, and listen through convergence.
pass: Audible flam converges to a stable single pulse.
syncLocked=true and abs(syncPhaseErrorBeats)<=0.01 at stable lock.
transportSeekCount does not increase after engagement.

tests.instructions: While locked with A leader, change A manual rate to 1.05x and allow the follower to settle.
pass: Follower returns to abs phase error<=0.01.
No hidden seek, audible jump, or dropout.

tests.instructions: While locked, capture A/B/mixer/SYNC status, run the provided 600 ms main-thread block, capture again, and listen.
pass: No audible dropout or obvious phase break.

tests.instructions: Disable SYNC, create an audible phase offset on A, then enable A to follow B and listen through convergence.
pass: Reverse leadership locks with abs follower phase error<=0.01.

tests.instructions: Keep the generated click pair locked for at least five minutes while using the browser normally.
pass: Final syncLocked=true and abs phase error<=0.01.

tests.instructions: Only if two ordinary tracks can be given accurate manual BPM and first-beat grids, test audible lock in both directions. Otherwise report NOT_EVALUATED; do not guess grids.

evidence_required: Human audible confirmation for generated convergence and five-minute hold.
SYNC telemetry after convergence, rate change, stress, reverse leadership, and five-minute hold.
Before/after transportSeekCount proving no hidden maintenance seeks.
report_rules: Do not patch product/system code from the report branch.
Push the report branch so the runner-backed debug bus relays it to issue #1.
